items.title: Provider terms, residency, training/retention and price ceiling
evidence: qwen3.8-flash real request 200; usage/provider request id recorded

console price snapshot 2026-10-26 recorded in assets/work-r0a-runtime-2026-10-25/usage/price-table.snapshot-2026-10-26.json with usableInLedger=false; R0a worst-path ceiling input 2.0 / output 8.0 / cached input 0.16 CNY per 1M tokens (DeepSeek peak tier plus Volcano cache tier, not any single provider list price)
items.note: Three providers (Alibaba Cloud Qwen, DeepSeek, Volcano Engine Doubao) are the floor; terms/DPA/residency/training-retention still unconfirmed. Decision request issued 2026-10-26. Unit prices are now recorded but they come from console screenshots, not a written price list: still missing effective date, change-notice period, the DeepSeek peak/idle window definition, and whether the Volcano cache-storage charge (0.017 per 1M tokens per hour) counts into run cost. Three ledger-shape constraints (PC-1 time-segmented price vs single-value price_version, PC-2 hourly cache-storage dimension, PC-3 per-provider concurrency limits) need a DR2 decision before price_version can be frozen. D-08a（2026-10-26 方向已定、未签收）：若签收，判定面收窄为阿里云一家（演示组织用我们的账号）；DeepSeek/火山改为客户自担 + 接入说明，PC-1/PC-2 作废。价目快照只作成本参考，usableInLedger=false。
